title: Does infusion therapy (with ocrelizumab or natalizumab) reduce fatigue in patients with multiple sclerosis?
summary:
Comparative observational study with two arms in the presence of different infusion therapy to influence the course of the disease in patients with multiple sclerosis.
The hypothesis is that due to B-cell depletion, there is a temporary significant change in fatigue after ocrelizumab infusion, but not with natalizumab infusion because it inhibits the inflammatory process in the brain, but not relevant peripheral autoimmune processes
conditions: relapsing remitting and secondary chronic Multiple sclerosis patients

interventions.name:
MS patients who come to the Klinikum Bremen-Ost for ocrelizumab infusion are admitted. After consent, the fatigue niceau is recorded five times: immediately before the next upcoming infusion, one or two weeks afterwards and 1 week before and directly before the following infusion treatment.
